data.content_ref: inline:Relation Kind: Contradiction. The 'Read-Only' archive approach (SRC_008) contradicts the 'Skeptic' validation layer (SRC_004) because SRC_008 treats local scripts as the source of truth and the tool as passive, whereas SRC_004 requires the platform to actively host provisional results pending independent reproduction; a read-only archive cannot serve as the active workspace for provisional tracking required by the skeptic stance. REFUTED IF the 'Read-Only' tool supports an external hook or sidecar process that allows the skeptic layer to write provisional status metadata without altering the core archive data.
